tanya: Quick ask 1 PR about structured output needs a tiny migration blurb + a fallback snippet for bad JSON. Can someone add a short PY + JS example?

ben: I can add the examples. Propose: show parse_with_schema / parseWithSchema helper first, then an explicit try/catch that records a `parse_failure` tag and uses `resp.text` as fallback.

oli: Also call out how function-calling differs: functions give deterministic args vs structured output that may still be freeform. Small note should prevent confusion.

katie: I'll add a one-liner about webhooks: consumers must check `Content-Type` and the `parse_failure` flag. If parse_failure=true, treat payload as human-readable only.

ben: Will also fix two stale links in the PR (old guide -> /docs/structured-output) and add a tiny migration diff block.

ci-bot: Reminder: docs-e2e job will run once changes are pushed.

tanya: Perfect. Aim to merge tomorrow morning. If anyone can't push, tag me and I'll land the small fixes. Thanks! :thumbsup:
